role_assignments_scope_shape.name: role_assignments_scope_shape
role_assignments_scope_shape.value:
("core"."role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'global' and "core"."role_assignments"."scope_department_id" is null and "core"."role_assignments"."scope_record_id" is null)
       or ("core"."role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department' and "core"."role_assignments"."scope_department_id" is not null)
       or ("core"."role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'record' and "core"."role_assignments"."scope_record_type" is not null and "core"."role_assignments"."scope_record_id" is not null)

approval_tasks_due_idx.name: approval_tasks_due_idx
approval_tasks_due_idx.where: "core"."approval_tasks"."status" = 'pending' and "core"."approval_tasks"."due_at" is not null and "core"."approval_tasks"."breached_at" is null

approval_tasks_remind_idx.name: approval_tasks_remind_idx
approval_tasks_remind_idx.where: "core"."approval_tasks"."status" = 'pending' and "core"."approval_tasks"."remind_at" is not null and "core"."approval_tasks"."reminded_at" is null
